title: Fix JavaScript deprecated API usage, optional chaining, and CSS accessibility issues
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
**JavaScript (memorysmith.js):**
- 10 instances of `&&` guard chains that should use optional chaining (`?.`)
- 3 deprecated API calls: `MediaQueryList.addListener` (L478), deprecated signature (L479), `document.execCommand` (L500)
- 1 regex with duplicate character class entries (L984)
- 1 potential object stringification issue (L1070)
- 1 pair of duplicate switch branches (L587-592)

**CSS (app.css):**
- 5 instances of text not meeting WCAG minimum contrast ratio (4.5:1)
- 3 duplicate CSS selectors
- 1 deprecated `word-break: break-word` keyword value

## Impact
Deprecated APIs will break in future browser versions. Poor contrast affects accessibility. Duplicate selectors cause confusing overrides.

## Action Required
1. Replace `a && a.b` with `a?.b` for optional chaining
2. Replace `addListener` with `addEventListener('change', ...)`; replace `document.execCommand('copy')` with `navigator.clipboard.writeText()`
3. Adjust CSS color values to meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio
4. Remove duplicate CSS selectors and consolidate rules
5. Replace `word-break: break-word` with `overflow-wrap: anywhere`

## Effort
~2h

## Priority
P3 — Maintainability/Accessibility
